examples.text: Haar slechthorende vriend kon goed liplezen om te begrijpen wat er werd gezegd.
examples.translation: Her hard-of-hearing friend could read lips well to understand what was being said.
examples.english: Her hard-of-hearing friend could read lips well to understand what was being said.

examples.text: In lawaaierige omgevingen kan het handig zijn om te kunnen liplezen om elkaar te verstaan.
examples.translation: In noisy environments, it can be useful to be able to read lips to understand each other.
examples.english: In noisy environments, it can be useful to be able to read lips to understand each other.

examples.text: De dove acteur had geleerd om zijn teksten te liplezen zodat hij kon meespelen in films en tv-shows.
examples.translation: The deaf actor had learned to read lips so he could act in movies and TV shows.
examples.english: The deaf actor had learned to read lips so he could act in movies and TV shows.
